errors.text: The predicted effect has the wrong sign: the target reports an approximately 12% conductivity increase with SRO, whereas the hypothesis predicts a greater than 15% reduction.
The cited evidence concerns dislocation mobility and DAPB formation during glide, not phonon transport or lattice thermal conductivity.
It treats DAPBs generated by dislocation motion as intrinsic phonon-scattering structures in an undeformed SRO alloy without supporting evidence.
It conflates the temperature-dependent attenuation of SRO dislocation strengthening with thermal destruction of SRO and a corresponding increase in phonon mean free path.
It misses the target mechanism of reduced lattice distortion and high-conductivity HfTi/TiZr percolation pathways in HfNbTaTiZr.
